name: mimo_understand
description: Multimodal understanding (image, audio, video) using Xiaomi MiMo

tools.name: understand_image
tools.description: Analyze and understand an image using MiMo vision. Describe contents, read text, identify objects, answer questions about the image.

url.description: URL of the image to analyze

prompt.description: What to analyze or ask about the image (default: describe the image)

tools.name: understand_audio
tools.description: Analyze and understand audio using MiMo. Transcribe speech, identify sounds, describe music, answer questions about audio content.

url.description: URL of the audio to analyze

prompt.description: What to analyze or ask about the audio (default: describe the content)

tools.name: understand_video
tools.description: Analyze and understand video using MiMo. Describe actions, identify objects, transcribe speech, answer questions about video content.

url.description: URL of the video to analyze

prompt.description: What to analyze or ask about the video (default: describe the content)
